Amber Example Air seeks cargo GSSA partners for Lithuania and Latvia

Amber Example Air invites expressions of interest from cargo GSSA providers for Lithuania and Latvia from April 2027, as its current cargo representation agreement ends.

The airline's cargo sales in Lithuania are currently handled by Nemunas Cargo Services UAB. Belly capacity is offered on its passenger flights between Kaunas (KUN) and Oslo (OSL). (Invented airline and notice: test fixture.)
